changelog: Phase B (P04-P07): Cleaned dead UI (removed Google sign-in button & dead RememberMe), removed plaintext password fallback in favor of strict bcrypt. Implemented DB-backed session resolution (getSessionUser) validating live roles/status directly from profiles. Set up atomic migration runner (scripts/migrate.ts) with migrations/README.md. Replaced in-memory login rate limiting with persistent Postgres login_attempts table.
